sect1.title: Final Keyword
sect1.para: Final keyword ले परिभाषाको अगाडि final थपेर child classes लाई कुनै method, property, वा constant override गर्नबाट रोक्छ। यदि class स्वयंलाई नै final परिभाषित गरिएको छ भने त्यसलाई extend गर्न सकिँदैन।

example.title: Final methods को उदाहरण
example.programlisting:
<?php
class BaseClass {
   public function test() {
       echo "BaseClass::test() called\n";
   }
   
   final public function moreTesting() {
       echo "BaseClass::moreTesting() called\n";
   }
}

class ChildClass extends BaseClass {
   public function moreTesting() {
       echo "ChildClass::moreTesting() called\n";
   }
}
// Results in Fatal error: Cannot override final method BaseClass::moreTesting()
?>

example.title: Final class को उदाहरण
example.programlisting:
<?php
final class BaseClass {
   public function test() {
       echo "BaseClass::test() called\n";
   }

   // As the class is already final, the final keyword is redundant
   final public function moreTesting() {
       echo "BaseClass::moreTesting() called\n";
   }
}

class ChildClass extends BaseClass {
}
// Results in Fatal error: Class ChildClass may not inherit from final class (BaseClass)
?>

example.title: PHP 8.4.0 देखि final property को उदाहरण
example.programlisting:
<?php
class BaseClass {
   final protected string $test;
}

class ChildClass extends BaseClass {
    public string $test;
}
// Results in Fatal error: Cannot override final property BaseClass::$test
?>

example.title: PHP 8.1.0 देखि final constants को उदाहरण
example.programlisting:
<?php
class Foo
{
    final public const X = "foo";
}

class Bar extends Foo
{
    public const X = "bar";
}

// Fatal error: Bar::X cannot override final constant Foo::X
?>

note.simpara: PHP 8.0.0 देखि, constructor बाहेक अन्य private methods लाई final घोषणा गर्न मिल्दैन।
private(set) का रूपमा घोषणा गरिएको property स्वतः (implicitly) final हुन्छ।
